scope: Authored native UR5e/Robotiq rigid-block manipulation, privileged state and synthetic commands. No shoe model, learned task policy, camera sensing, calibrated contact or physical qualification.

timing.scope: Wall computation, not real-time sensor-to-actuator latency. Includes setup, policy/IK, native physics, contacts, observations and trace construction; excludes process startup, output I/O and rendering

contract.scope: Authored native UR5e/Robotiq rigid-block manipulation, privileged state and synthetic commands. No shoe model, learned task policy, camera sensing, calibrated contact or physical qualification.

actions.joint_targets_rad: six absolute joint targets, rad; ramped then gravity feedforward
actions.gripper_0_255: one native tendon servo target; 0 open / 255 close, not measured gap or force

observations.pad_normal_forces_n: native mj_contactForce, not deployable tactile sensing

contract.contacts: native collision proxies; object priority 1 overrides pad/table friction floors
contract.object: one free rigid box; no weld, grasp attachment or runtime object pose writes
contract.success: valid physics, retained bilateral table-free lift and supported destination carry completion, then released/settled destination dwell and tool retreat

carry_retention.bilateral_contact_required: after sustained lift until supported at destination while held
carry_retention.loss_at_or_above_tolerance: permanent failure, independent of teacher phase
